items.title: Actual compact localization of the same weighted weak resolvent

source.anchor: PBPS2609.06905v1 Section2.2 equations2.6-2.14 and AppendixC.1 omitted same-solution compact localization analytic prerequisite; SPHMC2609.06906v1 Section4.1 actual BL dependency only. No numbered source localization theorem is claimed.
source.attribution: Samplinglib explicit same-solution compact localization prerequisite to Chen, Chewi, Lu and Zhang AppendixC.1; not a quoted numbered theorem or complete LemmaC.1/Poincare result.

items.statement: For the exact normalized Gibbs mu, original closable D fixed before epsilon/forcing, construct the actual resolvent u in D.closure.domain. Retain the actual all-domain variational equation, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all C1 compact directional weak-gradient tests, squared local integrability of r=epsilon*u+inner(grad W,G)-f, compact-volume L2 of u/G/r and every C2 original distribution test. For every C2 compact chi define v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi, Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi. Prove genuine global-volume L2 of v/Gchi/Fchi and each topological support contained in tsupport chi. For every C1 compact psi/direction a both weak-gradient products are L1 with integral psi inner(Gchi,a)=-integral v Dpsi[a]. For every C2 compact phi both PDE products are L1 with integral v Delta phi=integral Fchi phi. The same u is chosen before all cutoffs; only smooth test/cutoff functions have classical derivatives.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with Borel measurable structure and canonical full-space volume, including dimension zero. W is C1, exp(-W) is integrable, and mu is exactly volume.tilted(-W).

D is the original closable partial gradient on L2(mu), with graph exactly compact smooth scalar representatives and their genuine gradients modulo mu-a.e. D is fixed before epsilon>0 and forcing f in L2(mu). The genuine solution u/G/r and all local volume facts are derived, not supplied.

For every C2 real cutoff chi with compact topological support, the same u chosen before all chi yields explicit v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi and Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi. Neither sign, normalized mass, compact derivative bounds nor localized PDE/H2 certificate is assumed. All localized L2 and test integrals use volume; variational identities use L2(mu).

formulae.label: Actual compact localization of the same weighted weak resolvent
formulae.tex:
G=\overline Du,\ r=\varepsilon u+\langle
abla W,Gangle-f;\quad v=\chi u,\ G_\chi=\chi G+u
abla\chi,\ F_\chi=\chi r+2\langle
abla\chi,Gangle+u\Delta\chi;\quad v,G_\chi,F_\chi\in L^2(dx),\quad
abla v=G_\chi,\ \Delta v=F_\chi\quad	ext{weakly}.

obligations.label: Actual same-solution localized global-L2 weak gradient/PDE
Local H2, global operator core and Bochner (remaining)
Poincare/BL, main results and actual-input cost composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Same actual original D/u/G/r, one u before all C2 compact chi: derive actual compact support/global volume L2 of chi*u, chi*G+u*gradchi, chi*r+2<gradchi,G>+u*Delta chi, all C1 compact weak-gradient and C2 compact distribution PDE with every L1 term legal. No localized weighted closure-domain membership, H2, Schwartz/tempered adapter, global core/Bochner, BL/Poincare, epsilon0, noncompact domain, measurable y-selector or either main/composition. Reflected/RGO law/scale remain distinct; TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.
